question: Can the original nonlinear dressed boundary fields realize the actual native N=64 charged ground response by choosing any true ground state of the existing quarter-shifted boundary, with the same adjoint and a common physical time?
summary_de: Alle Grundzustandsmischungen und Kohärenzen des bereits gewählten masselosen Vaux-Randes mit -Q/4 werden zugelassen. Für 35 ursprüngliche ungerade Felder ist die volle geladene Antwort davon unabhängig: Hinzufügeenergien 7/4+n, Entnahmeenergien 5/4+n. Ihr Schwellenverhältnis 1.4 widerspricht dem nativen N=64-Grundzustand (>8.43495) bei jeder positiven gemeinsamen Zeitkalibrierung. Gleichverteilte Grundpopulationen und eine angepasste Wärmeglättung können trotzdem alle Besetzungen nachbilden; das erste Energiemoment bleibt strikt negativ statt nativ null. Keine Herleitung neuer Wechselwirkung oder allgemeine TFPT-Widerlegung.
assumptions: Existing conditional Gamma=I(9,1), F(E8), massless Vaux and H=L0+Lbar0-Q/4
Original dressed odd vertices p_i=F(FW_i/2)+e_R and their actual adjoints
All states supported on the complete two-dimensional ground space, including coherences
Common positive heat regularization preserving both charged lowest poles and a positive common time scale
Inherited certified native N=64 ground theorem at g/Delta=1/20 without mu N
kills: Repair this fixed dressed-field/time dictionary merely by selecting a different actual source ground state
Infer native ground dynamics from a fit of integrated charged response weights alone
Remove the charged spectral threshold mismatch by a global energy-zero shift or positive common time rescaling
leaves_open: Original-source derivation of the boundary channels, metric, interaction and state
Different source-derived nonlinear field/state/time maps preserving charged products and adjoints
Frequency-selective readouts with a separately justified physical map and controlled discarded response
Interacting pinned phases with a genuinely derived Hamiltonian
Full 3+1D, flavor, alpha, gravity and T1-T8 completion
not_claimed: The previously known two E8 grounds and Gaussian parity obstruction are not new results
No full historical native ground enumeration rerun
No microscopic selection of heat resolution or ground populations
No independent agent review or proof-assistant certification
